Raurava
a teacher of Śaiva doctrine, q. by Abhinavagupta in Īśvarapratyāsattivimarśinī.

Rauravatantra
or Rauravāgama. See below Rauravāgama.

Rauravanarakasūtra
q. by Nāgārjuna, in his Daśabhūmivibhāṣāśāstra; title restored by R. Kimura.
See IHQ. III. p. 416.

or Vārttika.
--name of C.. on the Rauravāgama. See below the text. [Page294-b]
